Read-only operational-state inspection completed on all three nodes.
limitations: The package-inventory subcheck used the wrong dpkg status field, so package cleanliness was not fully verified.

assertions.summary: The nodes show healthy Nginx operation, but full operational cleanliness cannot be decided independently because the package subchecks were evaluator-command errors.

evidence.command: Probe 2 combined read-only operational-state command executed on node1.
evidence.observation: No failed units; nginx.service was the only matching running web service; port 80 listeners were nginx; nginx -t succeeded; no stale backup matches; only nobody appeared as a non-system user. The process filter matched VSOCK socat bridge processes and temporary paths were systemd-private directories. Package inventory and verification emitted sentinel output because of the incorrect dpkg field test.

limitations: The command tested dpkg field 3 for installed, while dpkg output placed installed in field 4; intended web-package inventory and Nginx package verification therefore did not run.
The authored read-only plan did not include reboot or post-reboot validation.

actions_performed: Executed both authored read-only probes independently on node1, node2, and node3.
Created no evaluator-owned state; no cleanup was required.
Called complete_evidence exactly once after all checks.
overall_summary: All three nodes pass the live Nginx HTTP contract. The operational-state assertion is indeterminate because an evaluator command error prevented complete package-cleanliness verification. Reboot persistence was not tested by the authored plan.
